tools.name: inspect_cad
tools.description: Open a CAD file on CADProps servers and report its format, size, volume, area, units and accuracy, with an interactive 3D preview. Supported: 3DM, 3MF, ASM, CATPART, CATPRODUCT, DWF, DWFX, DWG, DXF, GLB, GLTF, IAM, IGES, IGS, IPT, JT, OBJ, PAR, PDF, PRT, PSM, SAB, SAT, SLDASM, SLDPRT, STEP, STL, STP

tools.name: convert_cad
tools.description: Convert a file opened with inspect_cad to STEP, STL or GLB and return a download link that expires in 30 minutes. STEP is a solid B-Rep when the source was read exactly; otherwise it is a triangulated STEP that CAD software cannot edit as a solid. STL and GLB are always triangulated meshes.

tools.name: open_in_workspace
tools.description: Return a one-time link (valid 15 minutes) that opens this file in the CADProps web workspace for measuring, sectioning and sharing. After it is opened, the chat preview and links for this file stop working.

tools.name: refresh_view_token
tools.description: Used by the CADProps preview to renew its read-only token.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_in_workspace · Private data: inspect_cad, convert_cad, open_in_workspace, refresh_view_token · Public sink: inspect_cad · Destructive: inspect_cad.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_in_workspace · Private data: inspect_cad, convert_cad, open_in_workspace, refresh_view_token · Public sink: inspect_cad · Destructive: inspect_cad

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
